subject: urn:chicago:agentic-payment:purchase-001

narrative.headline: Agentic purchase completes under a delegated, receipted payment authority
narrative.customerProblem: Buyers cannot see, before checkout, which platform capabilities actually stand behind an automated payment and which are still candidates.
narrative.desiredOutcome: A purchase closes end to end with every layer's standing visible and every refusal carrying a typed recovery path.
narrative.semanticPath: semantic work order -> capability admission -> delegated payment actuation -> receipt -> replay -> standing

scenarios.label: Single charge under valid delegation
scenarios.description: A single card charge inside the delegation limit completes and a receipt seals the run.

scenarios.label: Dispatch outcome unknown, evidence binds later
scenarios.description: Dispatch returns unknown; the case recovers when a later receipt binds the observed execution.

scenarios.label: Multi-item cart within budget
scenarios.description: A multi-item cart totals under the delegated budget and closes in one settled payment.

scenarios.label: Cart exceeds delegation ceiling
scenarios.description: A cart total above the delegated limit is refused before any payment leaves the account.

scenarios.label: Wrong principal
scenarios.description: A payment requested by a principal other than the delegated one is refused without dispatch.

scenarios.label: Retry after transient provider failure
scenarios.description: A transient provider failure is retried idempotently and the second attempt completes.

scenarios.label: Provider unavailable
scenarios.description: No enabled provider can take the charge, so the case stops with a typed refusal.

scenarios.label: Expired delegation is renewed then charged
scenarios.description: An expired delegation is renewed by the operator and the purchase then completes lawfully.

scenarios.label: Receipt replay reproduces the same head
scenarios.description: Replaying the receipted purchase reproduces a byte-identical outcome on the same subject.

scenarios.label: Policy drift detected mid-flight
scenarios.description: A policy digest drift is detected between admission and dispatch and the case is refused.

authorityBoundaries: authorityClaim NONE — this surface observes and never actuates
cases are candidate predictions, never pre-judged outcomes
standing stays UNKNOWN until a real receipt binds observed execution
no provider identity enters the work order identity

failureRecovery.recovery: Wait for the provider event stream to bind a receipt, then re-observe standing on the exact subject.
Split the cart below the ceiling or request a raised delegation, then re-run the case.
Re-request the payment under the delegated principal; the surface never substitutes one.
Enable another provider on the routing table; work order identity survives the provider change.
Re-render the projection from the source graph, re-admit the case, and retry on the fresh digest.
